audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] and early both say Kayle's 'ranged auto' wins the level-1 poke. Kayle is melee at level 1 — the attack range arrives with Divine Ascent as she levels. The page's own spikes[3] says 'ranged form' is a late breakpoint, contradicting its own opening line. Separately, Highlander's slow immunity is never mentioned, and Meditate is never named as a heal.
audit.why: Telling the player they out-range Master Yi at level 1 invites the exact walk-up that gets punished by Alpha Strike into Wuju Style. And the late-game plan is kiting with Radiant Blast's slow — against Highlander that slow does nothing at all, which is the single most important interaction in the matchup and it is absent.
audit.corrected: Level 1 restated as both champions melee with Alpha Strike on 20s. Highlander's 85s slow immunity written into late. Meditate named as a 10s heal channel with Grievous Wounds attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appears anywhere in the matchup, and Wuju Style's true damage is described as 'true damage you cannot answer yet' — as though it becomes answerable later.
audit.why: True damage ignores armour and MR permanently, not until you buy something. A player reading 'yet' will buy resists expecting the trade to improve. The numbers that gate the lane — Alpha Strike 20s, Meditate 10s, Highlander 85s, Divine Judgment 160s — are all missing.
audit.corrected: Those four cooldowns written into whys[0], whys[3], mid and late; 'yet' removed from the true-damage line.
